## Spotting Overhead Exercises

Ideally, to promote safety of the athlete during lifts with the bar on the back, or front of the shoulders, a power rack with the safety crossbars in place at an appropriate height is recommended. Clear all objects that might cause tripping from the lifting area. One of the most common causes of injury in a weight training area is tripping over a weight plate on the floor. Nonparticipating athletes should stay clear of the lifting area and avoid distracting the lifter's attention by standing or moving in front of the athlete. Spotters must be strong enough and tall enough to catch unstable weights and match the height of the athlete.
